examples.text_en: The historian wrote a short book about the war.
examples.text_zh: 这位历史学家写了一本关于那场战争的短书。

examples.text_en: Two historians came to our school to give a talk.
examples.text_zh: 两位历史学家来到我们学校做了一场讲座。

examples.text_en: His histrionic reaction made everyone at the table laugh.
examples.text_zh: 他矫揉造作的反应让桌上的每个人都笑了。

examples.text_en: She gave a histrionic speech at the small party.
examples.text_zh: 她在那场小型聚会上发表了一通矫揉造作的讲话。

examples.text_en: The problem had hitherto been kept a secret.
examples.text_zh: 这个问题迄今一直是个秘密。

examples.text_en: Hitherto we had no way to solve it.
examples.text_zh: 至今我们都没有办法解决它。

examples.text_en: The bees built a hive under the wooden roof.
examples.text_zh: 蜜蜂在木屋顶下筑了一个蜂房。

examples.text_en: A hive of bees hung from the tall tree.
examples.text_zh: 一窝蜜蜂挂在那棵高大的树上。

examples.text_en: The hoary joke still made the children laugh.
examples.text_zh: 这个老掉牙的笑话还是让孩子们笑了。

examples.text_en: His hoary hair fell over his tired face.
examples.text_zh: 他花白的头发垂在疲惫的脸上。

examples.text_en: They used a hoist to lift the heavy box.
examples.text_zh: 他们用起重机吊起那个重箱子。

examples.text_en: The hoist made the work much easier for us.
examples.text_zh: 起重机让我们的工作轻松多了。

examples.text_en: The holder of the ticket must show some proof.
examples.text_zh: 持票人必须出示一些证明。

examples.text_en: She is the holder of two world records.
examples.text_zh: 她是两项世界纪录的保持者。

examples.text_en: The film told of a holocaust that destroyed the town.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影讲述了摧毁小镇的一场大火灾。

examples.text_en: They talked about the holocaust in the history class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在历史课上谈到那场大屠杀。

examples.text_en: The museum keeps a holograph of the famous letter.
examples.text_zh: 博物馆保存着那封著名信件的亲笔手稿。

examples.text_en: He gave the library a holograph signed by the writer.
examples.text_zh: 他把一份由作家签名的亲笔文件捐给了图书馆。

examples.text_en: The man kept his gun in a leather holster.
examples.text_zh: 那人把枪放在皮手枪套里。

examples.text_en: He put the holster on the table.
examples.text_zh: 他把手枪套放在桌上。

examples.text_en: The film is a warm homage to his home town.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影是对他家乡的一份温情致敬。

examples.text_en: They paid homage to the teacher who helped them.
examples.text_zh: 他们向那位帮助过他们的老师表达了敬意。

examples.text_en: They lived in a homely little house.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在一栋朴实的小房子里。

examples.text_en: The food was homely but very good.
examples.text_zh: 这饭菜很家常，但非常好吃。

examples.text_en: She gave us some homemade food for the trip.
examples.text_zh: 她给了我们一些自制食物路上吃。

examples.text_en: The homemade box was strong and well made.
examples.text_zh: 这个自制的盒子结实又做得好。

examples.text_en: Homeostasis keeps the body in a steady state.
examples.text_zh: 体内平衡使身体保持稳定状态。

examples.text_en: They studied homeostasis in the science class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在科学课上研究体内平衡。

examples.text_en: Her homespun manner put the guests at ease.
examples.text_zh: 她朴实的举止让客人们放松下来。

examples.text_en: He told a homespun story about his early life.
examples.text_zh: 他讲了一个关于早年生活的朴素故事。

examples.text_en: He studied homiletics before he became a teacher.
examples.text_zh: 他在成为教师之前学过说教术。

examples.text_en: The school offers a course in homiletics each year.
examples.text_zh: 学校每年开设一门说教术课程。

examples.text_en: The teacher gave us a short homily about being kind.
examples.text_zh: 老师就善待他人给我们做了简短的说教。

examples.text_en: His homily on hard work lasted a long time.
examples.text_zh: 他关于努力工作的那番训诫持续了很久。

examples.text_en: This hominid walked on two legs long ago.
examples.text_zh: 这种人科动物很久以前就用两条腿行走。

examples.text_en: Scientists found the bones of an early hominid.
examples.text_zh: 科学家发现了一种早期人科动物的骨头。

examples.text_en: The town's homogeneity surprised the young visitor.
examples.text_zh: 小镇的同质性让这位年轻的访客感到惊讶。

examples.text_en: They worried about the homogeneity of the group.
examples.text_zh: 他们担心这个群体的同质性。

examples.text_en: The people in the town were quite homogeneous.
examples.text_zh: 镇上的人相当同质。

examples.text_en: They lived in a homogeneous group for years.
examples.text_zh: 他们多年住在一个同质的群体里。

examples.text_en: The machine can homogenize the milk in a minute.
examples.text_zh: 这台机器能在一分钟内把牛奶搅匀。

examples.text_en: They tried to homogenize the two very different groups.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图把这两个截然不同的群体变得一致。

examples.text_en: A homograph looks the same but has two meanings.
examples.text_zh: 同形异义字看起来一样，却有两个意思。

examples.text_en: The class learned about the homograph today.
examples.text_zh: 今天课上学习了同形异义字。

examples.text_en: He used a hone to make the tool sharp.
examples.text_zh: 他用磨刀石把工具磨锋利。

examples.text_en: Time will hone his skill at the work.
examples.text_zh: 时间会磨练他做这项工作的本领。

examples.text_en: They gave the young speaker a small honorarium.
examples.text_zh: 他们给那位年轻演讲者一小笔酬金。

examples.text_en: The honorarium was enough for a good meal.
examples.text_zh: 这笔酬金够吃一顿好饭。

examples.text_en: It is a great honour to meet you today.
examples.text_zh: 今天见到您是我的莫大荣幸。

examples.text_en: They showed him honour for his long service.
examples.text_zh: 他们因他多年的服务而向他表示敬意。

examples.text_en: He was an honourable man who kept his word.
examples.text_zh: 他是个守信用的值得尊敬的人。

examples.text_en: It was an honourable thing to do for a friend.
examples.text_zh: 为朋友做这件事是值得尊敬的。

examples.text_en: They tried to hoodwink us with a false story.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图用假故事蒙蔽我们。

examples.text_en: He would hoodwink anyone to get his way.
examples.text_zh: 为了达到目的，他会欺骗任何人。

examples.text_en: The children rolled a hoop down the hill.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们把一个铁环滚下山坡。

examples.text_en: She jumped through a hoop at the show.
examples.text_zh: 她在表演中穿过了铁环。

examples.text_en: Hooray! We have won the big game.
examples.text_zh: 万岁！我们赢下了那场大赛。

examples.text_en: They gave a loud hooray for the team.
examples.text_zh: 他们为球队大声欢呼。

examples.text_en: A horde of people came into the small town.
examples.text_zh: 一群人涌入这个小镇。

examples.text_en: The horde moved across the open land.
examples.text_zh: 这群人穿过开阔的土地。

examples.text_en: The hornbill has a very big and strange bill.
examples.text_zh: 犀鸟有一个又大又奇怪的喙。

examples.text_en: We saw a hornbill near the water.
examples.text_zh: 我们在水边看到一只犀鸟。

examples.text_en: He learned horology from a master in his town.
examples.text_zh: 他在镇上从一位师傅那里学会了钟表制造术。

examples.text_en: Her book on horology explains how clocks work.
examples.text_zh: 她那本关于钟表制造术的书解释了钟表如何运作。

examples.text_en: The storm caused horrendous damage to the small town.
examples.text_zh: 这场风暴给小镇造成了可怕的破坏。

examples.text_en: They had a horrendous time on the long trip.
examples.text_zh: 他们在漫长的旅途中过得糟透了。

examples.text_en: The news of the horrific fire spread fast.
examples.text_zh: 那场可怕火灾的消息迅速传开。

examples.text_en: She could not forget the horrific scene.
examples.text_zh: 她无法忘记那令人毛骨悚然的场景。

examples.text_en: This small car has enough horsepower for the city.
examples.text_zh: 这辆小车有足够的马力应付城市路况。

examples.text_en: The engine produces more horsepower than before.
examples.text_zh: 这台发动机产生的马力比以前更大。

examples.text_en: His hortative words helped us work harder.
examples.text_zh: 他劝告的话让我们更努力地工作。

examples.text_en: She gave a hortative talk to the young team.
examples.text_zh: 她给年轻的团队做了一次劝勉的讲话。

examples.text_en: He studied horticulture and loved to grow food.
examples.text_zh: 他研究园艺，喜欢种食物。

examples.text_en: Horticulture is the art of growing plants.
examples.text_zh: 园艺是种植植物的技艺。

examples.text_en: He used a hose to wash the car.
examples.text_zh: 他用水管洗车。

examples.text_en: The garden hose is lying on the grass.
examples.text_zh: 花园水管放在草地上。

examples.text_en: The group was hostile to our new ideas.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体对我们的新想法怀有敌意。

examples.text_en: He gave us a hostile look at the door.
examples.text_zh: 他在门口敌意地看了我们一眼。

examples.text_en: There was open hostility between the two groups.
examples.text_zh: 两个群体之间公开敌对。

examples.text_en: His words showed deep hostility to the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他的话显示出对这项计划的深深敌意。

examples.text_en: The young player likes to hotdog after each goal.
examples.text_zh: 这名年轻球员每进一球就爱炫耀卖弄。

examples.text_en: Do not hotdog in front of the other team.
examples.text_zh: 不要在其他球队面前卖弄。

examples.text_en: She takes care of the housekeeping for her family.
examples.text_zh: 她负责家里的家务。

examples.text_en: Good housekeeping keeps a home clean and warm.
examples.text_zh: 良好的家政让家干净又温馨。

examples.text_en: They lived in a cold hovel near the river.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在河边一间冰冷的简陋小屋里。

examples.text_en: The poor family shared a tiny hovel.
examples.text_zh: 这户穷苦人家共用一间小小的破屋。

examples.text_en: The baby was a real howler last night.
examples.text_zh: 这孩子昨晚哭得可凶了。

examples.text_en: The little howler would not stop all night.
examples.text_zh: 这个小哭包整晚都停不下来。

examples.text_en: The city is a hub for trade and travel.
examples.text_zh: 这座城市是贸易和旅行的中心。

examples.text_en: This busy port became the hub of the region.
examples.text_zh: 这个繁忙的港口成了该地区的中心。

examples.text_en: The hubbub in the hall died down quickly.
examples.text_zh: 大厅里的喧闹声很快平息下来。

examples.text_en: We could hear the hubbub from the next room.
examples.text_zh: 我们能听到隔壁房间传来的喧闹声。

examples.text_en: His hubris made him think he could never fail.
examples.text_zh: 他的傲慢让他以为自己永远不会失败。

examples.text_en: The story is a warning about hubris.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事是对傲慢的一个警告。

examples.text_en: The huckster sold food from a small cart.
examples.text_zh: 小商人用小推车卖食物。

examples.text_en: A huckster called out to people in the street.
examples.text_zh: 一个小贩在街上向人们叫卖。

examples.text_en: There was a huddle of people near the door.
examples.text_zh: 门口附近挤着一堆人。

examples.text_en: The team stood in a huddle before the game.
examples.text_zh: 比赛前队伍围成一团。

examples.text_en: The sky changed hue as the sun went down.
examples.text_zh: 太阳落下时天空变了颜色。

examples.text_en: Her dress was a soft hue of blue.
examples.text_zh: 她的裙子是一种柔和的蓝色调。

examples.text_en: The rusting hulk sat on the empty beach.
examples.text_zh: 那艘生锈的废船停在空荡的海滩上。

examples.text_en: A huge hulk of a ship blocked the view.
examples.text_zh: 一艘巨大的船挡住了视线。

examples.text_en: The hull of the boat was full of holes.
examples.text_zh: 船体上满是洞。

examples.text_en: They painted the hull a bright shade of red.
examples.text_zh: 他们把船壳漆成一种鲜亮的红色。

examples.text_en: It was a humane act to help the poor man.
examples.text_zh: 帮助这个穷人是一种人道的举动。

examples.text_en: They asked for humane treatment of the animals.
examples.text_zh: 他们要求人道地对待动物。

examples.text_en: The humanist loved art, books, and people.
examples.text_zh: 这位人道主义者热爱艺术、书籍和人民。

examples.text_en: She was a humanist who cared about all people.
examples.text_zh: 她是个关心所有人的人道主义者。

examples.text_en: His humanistic view put people before money.
examples.text_zh: 他的人本主义观点把人的价值置于金钱之上。

examples.text_en: The school is known for its humanistic approach.
examples.text_zh: 这所学校以其人本主义的方式闻名。

examples.text_en: It was a humdrum day with nothing to do.
examples.text_zh: 那是单调无聊、无事可做的一天。

examples.text_en: He was tired of his humdrum life.
examples.text_zh: 他厌倦了自己平凡单调的生活。

examples.text_en: The humidity made the hot day feel worse.
examples.text_zh: 湿气让炎热的一天更加难受。

examples.text_en: They talked about the humidity of the summer air.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈到夏天空气的湿度。

examples.text_en: Losing the game was a great humiliation for him.
examples.text_zh: 输掉比赛对他来说是极大的耻辱。

examples.text_en: She could not forget the humiliation of that day.
examples.text_zh: 她无法忘记那天的屈辱。

examples.text_en: A camel stores fat in its hump.
examples.text_zh: 骆驼把脂肪储存在驼峰里。

examples.text_en: The road goes over a small hump near the bridge.
examples.text_zh: 这条路在桥附近越过一个小隆起。

examples.text_en: He cut off a large hunk of bread.
examples.text_zh: 他切下一大块面包。

examples.text_en: A hunk of ice fell from the roof.
examples.text_zh: 一大块冰从屋顶上掉了下来。

examples.text_en: Money was the biggest hurdle for the young team.
examples.text_zh: 资金是这支年轻队伍最大的障碍。

examples.text_en: They cleared every hurdle and won the game.
examples.text_zh: 他们跨越了每一道跳栏，赢得了比赛。

examples.text_en: He made a strong hurl across the open field.
examples.text_zh: 他用力朝开阔的田野投掷。

examples.text_en: With one hurl she sent the box into the sea.
examples.text_zh: 她用力一掷，把盒子扔进了海里。

examples.text_en: A loud hurrah went up from the crowd.
examples.text_zh: 人群中响起一声响亮的欢呼。

examples.text_en: The children gave a hurrah when the show began.
examples.text_zh: 演出开始时孩子们欢呼了一声。

examples.text_en: Good husbandry keeps the farm animals healthy.
examples.text_zh: 良好的饲养方式让农场的动物保持健康。

examples.text_en: He learned animal husbandry from his father.
examples.text_zh: 他从父亲那里学会了牲畜饲养。

examples.text_en: A sudden hush fell over the busy room.
examples.text_zh: 忙碌的房间里突然安静下来。

examples.text_en: There was a hush before the music started.
examples.text_zh: 音乐开始前有一阵寂静。

examples.text_en: The husky worked hard in the cold air.
examples.text_zh: 这个强壮的人在寒风中努力工作。

examples.text_en: He was a husky young man with a big heart.
examples.text_zh: 他是个身体结实的年轻人，心地很好。

examples.text_en: The plant is a hybrid of two different kinds.
examples.text_zh: 这种植物是两种不同种类的杂交品种。

examples.text_en: The word is a hybrid of two languages.
examples.text_zh: 这个词是两种语言的混合体。

examples.text_en: A red fire hydrant stands near the corner.
examples.text_zh: 一个红色的消防栓立在拐角附近。

examples.text_en: The dog stopped beside the fire hydrant.
examples.text_zh: 那只狗在消防栓旁停了下来。

examples.text_en: The bridge used a hydraulic system to open.
examples.text_zh: 这座桥用液压系统开合。

examples.text_en: They used a hydraulic machine to lift the box.
examples.text_zh: 他们用液压机器抬起箱子。

examples.text_en: Oil is a hydrocarbon that we use every day.
examples.text_zh: 石油是我们每天使用的碳氢化合物。

examples.text_en: They studied the hydrocarbon in the science class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在科学课上研究碳氢化合物。

examples.text_en: The hydrosphere covers most of the earth.
examples.text_zh: 水圈覆盖了地球的大部分。

examples.text_en: Water in the hydrosphere moves around the world.
examples.text_zh: 水圈中的水在世界各地流动。

examples.text_en: Good hygiene helps us stay well and safe.
examples.text_zh: 良好的卫生保健帮助我们保持健康平安。

examples.text_en: The school taught the children about hygiene.
examples.text_zh: 学校教孩子们讲卫生。

examples.text_en: The group sang a hymn at the morning service.
examples.text_zh: 这群人在晨间礼拜上唱了一首赞美诗。

examples.text_en: She knew every hymn in the small book.
examples.text_zh: 那本小册子里的每首圣歌她都会唱。

examples.text_en: Hyperactivity can make it hard for a child to sit still.
examples.text_zh: 活动过多会让孩子难以安静坐着。

examples.text_en: They talked about hyperactivity in the young boy.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈到那个小男孩的活动过多。

examples.text_en: His words were full of hyperbole and big promises.
examples.text_zh: 他的话里满是夸张和空头承诺。

examples.text_en: They used hyperbole to make the story more fun.
examples.text_zh: 他们用夸张法让故事更有趣。

examples.text_en: The child was hypersensitive to loud sounds.
examples.text_zh: 这孩子对大声响很敏感。

examples.text_en: He was hypersensitive and took every word to heart.
examples.text_zh: 他太敏感，把每句话都放在心上。

examples.text_en: The doctor warned him that hypertension can be dangerous.
examples.text_zh: 医生警告他高血压可能很危险。

examples.text_en: She takes medicine for her hypertension every day.
examples.text_zh: 她每天服用治疗高血压的药。

examples.text_en: You need a hyphen between these two words.
examples.text_zh: 这两个词之间需要一个连字符。

examples.text_en: The word has a hyphen in the middle.
examples.text_zh: 这个词中间有一个连字符。

examples.text_en: The music had a slow and hypnotic sound.
examples.text_zh: 这音乐有一种缓慢而催眠的声音。

examples.text_en: Her eyes had a strange hypnotic power.
examples.text_zh: 她的眼睛有一种奇特的催眠力量。

examples.text_en: He called his friend a hypocrite for lying.
examples.text_zh: 他因为朋友撒谎称其为伪君子。

examples.text_en: A hypocrite says one thing and does another.
examples.text_zh: 伪君子说一套做一套。

examples.text_en: The doctor used a hypodermic needle for the shot.
examples.text_zh: 医生用皮下注射针打针。

examples.text_en: She felt the hypodermic shot in her arm.
examples.text_zh: 她感到手臂上一阵皮下注射。

examples.text_en: The hypotenuse is the long side of a right triangle.
examples.text_zh: 斜边是直角三角形最长的一边。

examples.text_en: They found the hypotenuse in the math class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在数学课上求斜边。

examples.text_en: The scientists had two hypotheses about the problem.
examples.text_zh: 科学家们对这个问题有两个假说。

examples.text_en: They tested their hypotheses with new data.
examples.text_zh: 他们用新数据检验自己的假说。

examples.text_en: Scientists hypothesize that the sea was once warm.
examples.text_zh: 科学家们假设这片海曾经是温暖的。

examples.text_en: We can only hypothesize about what happened next.
examples.text_zh: 对于接下来发生了什么，我们只能假设。

examples.text_en: The news caused a wave of hysteria in the crowd.
examples.text_zh: 这条消息在人群中引起了一阵歇斯底里。

examples.text_en: Her hysteria faded once she heard his voice.
examples.text_zh: 听到他的声音后，她的歇斯底里就消退了。

examples.text_en: The child became hysterical when the dog barked.
examples.text_zh: 狗一叫，那孩子就歇斯底里起来。

examples.text_en: She found his hysterical laughter hard to bear.
examples.text_zh: 她觉得他那歇斯底里的大笑让人难以忍受。

examples.text_en: We need two things, i.e. food and water.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要两样东西，也就是食物和水。

examples.text_en: She spoke for a long time, i.e. about an hour.
examples.text_zh: 她讲了很长时间，也就是大约一小时。

examples.text_en: We bought ice cream on a hot summer day.
examples.text_zh: 我们在一个炎热的夏日买了冰淇淋。

examples.text_en: The children want ice cream after their dinner.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们想在晚饭后吃冰淇淋。

examples.text_en: He bought an ice-cream for his young son.
examples.text_zh: 他给小儿子买了一份冰淇淋。

examples.text_en: The ice-cream shop was full of happy children.
examples.text_zh: 冰淇淋店里挤满了快乐的孩子。

examples.text_en: The ichthyosaur lived in the sea long ago.
examples.text_zh: 鱼龙很久以前生活在海里。

examples.text_en: They found the bones of an ichthyosaur.
examples.text_zh: 他们发现了鱼龙的骨头。

examples.text_en: A long icicle hung from the roof.
examples.text_zh: 一根长长的冰柱挂在屋檐下。

examples.text_en: The icicle broke when the sun came out.
examples.text_zh: 太阳出来时那根冰柱断了。

examples.text_en: The icing on the cake was soft and sweet.
examples.text_zh: 蛋糕上的糖衣又软又甜。

examples.text_en: She put the icing on the food with care.
examples.text_zh: 她小心地把糖衣浇在食物上。

examples.text_en: He is an icon for many young fans.
examples.text_zh: 对许多年轻粉丝来说，他是个偶像。

examples.text_en: Click the small icon to open the file.
examples.text_zh: 点击那个小图标就能打开文件。

examples.text_en: The young painter was seen as an iconoclast.
examples.text_zh: 这位年轻画家被视为一个打破旧习的人。

examples.text_en: An iconoclast often questions the rules of his time.
examples.text_zh: 一个反传统者常常质疑他所处时代的规则。

examples.text_en: Her iconoclastic ideas upset some of the teachers.
examples.text_zh: 她打破旧习的想法让一些老师感到不安。

examples.text_en: He took an iconoclastic view of the family rules.
examples.text_zh: 他对家规持一种反传统的看法。

examples.text_en: The book gives an iconographic study of the church.
examples.text_zh: 这本书对那座教堂做了图像学的研究。

examples.text_en: Her iconographic method changed how we read the paintings.
examples.text_zh: 她的图像学方法改变了我们解读这些画作的方式。

examples.text_en: His idealism made him want to change the world.
examples.text_zh: 他的理想主义让他想改变世界。

examples.text_en: They talked about idealism in the history class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在历史课上谈到唯心主义。

examples.text_en: The writer is easily identifiable by his style.
examples.text_zh: 这位作家很容易凭其风格被辨认出来。

examples.text_en: No identifiable marks were left on the wall.
examples.text_zh: 墙上没有留下任何可辨认的痕迹。

examples.text_en: The two groups had very different ideological views.
examples.text_zh: 两个群体有着截然不同的意识形态观点。

examples.text_en: They talked about the ideological war of that time.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈到那个时代的意识形态之争。

examples.text_en: He laughed at the sheer idiocy of the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他对这个计划十足的愚蠢感到好笑。

examples.text_en: She could not believe the idiocy of his words.
examples.text_zh: 她不敢相信他说的话有多愚蠢。
